name: sf
description: Software factory — run a feature idea→open PR through a left-shifted gated pipeline, start from an investigation (sf:investigate) when the input is a reported bug, or enter at any phase (plan/build/review/ci-green) and resume from saved state in .scratch/<slug>/.

branchPrefix.title: Branch author prefix
branchPrefix.description: Prefix for branches sf creates: <prefix>/feat-PRE-123-title. Leave blank to use your shell username (whoami). Prompted once at install; change later with /plugin configure sf.
